{{Conjecture|legends}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Jackson Farseeker]] met a '''tentacled alien''' in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. They left together, [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] before [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] entered the establishment in search of Farseeker. Members of a [[Unidentified hive-mind insectoid species|hive-mind insectoid species]] informed Garnet of the meeting after being paid a number of [[credit token]]s.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
